rules.title_fa: شیب سطح بام مسطح
design_actions: grade flat roof surfaces at not less than 2 percent toward roof drains

rules.title_fa: حداقل دو کفشوی و دو قائم بام اصلی

exceptions.predicate: roof_role in [PENTHOUSE_ROOF,BALCONY]

design_actions: provide at least two distinct roof drains and two distinct rainwater stacks on the main roof

rules.title_fa: استقلال شبکه آب باران از فاضلاب
design_actions: keep rainwater nodes and edges separate from sanitary and vent networks
output_evidence: no shared sanitary or vent node identity

rules.title_fa: پیش‌بینی شفت مناسب مسیر ثانویه یا اضطراری
design_actions: reserve a suitable services shaft or explicitly coordinated equivalent path for secondary or emergency rainwater discharge

rules.title_fa: جدایی مسیر و نقطه تخلیه شبکه فرعی
design_actions: provide secondary routes and discharge points distinct from the primary network and above its elevation

rules.title_fa: مبنای رسمی حداکثر بارندگی یک‌ساعته
design_actions: size rainwater pipes from official maximum one-hour rainfall with return period at least 30 years

rules.title_fa: مسیر اضطراری در انسداد کامل مسیر اصلی
design_actions: provide an unobstructed emergency path to an appropriate discharge location
make emergency discharge visible to users or maintenance staff
request structural verification of maximum ponded-water load under complete primary blockage

rules.title_fa: صافی، دوام و اتصال آب‌بند کفشوی
design_actions: specify corrosion, sunlight and temperature resistant roof drain
provide fixed strainer at least 100 mm above roof
provide strainer open area at least 1.5 times stack opening
detail watertight roof membrane connection

rules.title_fa: شیب لوله افقی آب باران
design_actions: route horizontal rainwater pipes with uniform fall away from stacks and no reverse slope

rules.title_fa: حداقل قطر قائم و منع مصرف مشترک
design_actions: use rainwater stacks of at least DN80
do not use rainwater stacks as sanitary or vent stacks

rules.title_fa: منع کاهش قطر در جهت جریان
design_actions: maintain or increase nominal diameter in the direction of flow

rules.title_fa: جداول راهنمای ظرفیت قائم و افقی پیوست ۷

exceptions.predicate: capacity table anomaly row DN250 at 4 percent
exceptions.result: preserve printed value and require engineer review

design_actions: apply one-hour rainfall correction to printed Appendix 7 capacities without silently correcting print anomalies

rules.title_fa: وابستگی بار باران سازه‌ای و آب‌ماندگی
design_actions: request structural rain-load R and ponding-stability verification; never substitute rainfall intensity

rules.title_fa: ردیابی یکسان محاسبه، پلان، رایزر و جدول
design_actions: retain identical Calc, Plan, Riser and Schedule identity for every rainwater segment

rules.title_fa: تحمل فشار استاتیک کل ارتفاع
design_actions: select every pipe fitting and joint for the full blocked-column static head

rules.title_fa: اتصال‌های ممنوع و سازگاری جنس
design_actions: reject cement concrete bituminous-paste unlike-plastic adhesive and unequal-diameter rubber-ring joints

rules.title_fa: محل، فاصله، اندازه و دسترسی دریچه بازدید
design_actions: place cleanouts at stack bases, direction changes over 45 degrees, main-line intervals, and immediately outside the building

rules.title_fa: حفاظت فرابنفش، یخبندان، ضربه، خوردگی و حریق
design_actions: protect components against each applicable sunlight frost corrosion impact and fire-rated penetration condition

rules.title_fa: بار، جنس، مهار و فاصله بست‌ها
design_actions: design supports for water-full pipe and applicable insulation thermal wind seismic snow and ice actions
use the smallest permitted spacing for shared supports and manufacturer-approved spacing where the table has no row

rules.title_fa: تخلیه بام بالاتر و حفاظت محل برخورد

exceptions.predicate: upper_roof_discharges_to_lower_roof == false

design_actions: turn vertical flow horizontal with one 90-degree or two 45-degree elbows and protect the lower-roof impact point with stone or concrete

rules.title_fa: آزمون نشت با هد کامل پیش از پوشش
design_actions: keep work exposed and fill highest stacks and lowest horizontal network for at least 15 minutes at full static head; repair and repeat after leakage

rules.title_fa: گواهی کیفیت، انطباق و مارک دائمی اجزای باران
design_actions: schedule each pipe fitting and roof drain with permanent manufacturer and approved-standard marks and separately require a competent-body test and conformity certificate

rules.title_fa: سطح مؤثر دیوار مجاور و انتقال چندتراز بدون دوباره‌شماری
design_actions: use horizontal roof projection plus one half only of each proven contributing wall and add each upstream transfer exactly once

rules.title_fa: انتخاب قائم و افقی از جداول کامل پیوست ۷

exceptions.predicate: horizontal DN250 at 4 percent
exceptions.result: preserve printed 15984 m2 and 112.52 L/s; require anomaly acknowledgement

design_actions: correct printed table area by 25.4 divided by official one-hour intensity and size vertical and horizontal components independently without interpolating unprinted slopes

rules.title_fa: ترنچ، بستر، دفن و خاکریزی شبکه ثقلی

exceptions.predicate: no buried gravity rainwater segment is present

design_actions: provide continuous shaped soft sand/gravel support, 150 mm compacted lifts, at least 75 mm rock overcut and two-diameter weak-soil overexcavation where applicable

rules.title_fa: هدایت آب بام، منع مزاحمت و مقصد مجاز تخلیه
design_actions: route roof water without nuisance, facade runoff, adjacent-property discharge or public-way discharge; surface discharge inside the property remains permit-dependent

rules.title_fa: تداوم عایق رطوبتی در رابط‌های آب باران

exceptions.predicate: surface_type == LOW_EXPOSURE_BALCONY and exposure classification is source-verified

design_actions: materialize a source-entity waterproofing upstand and sealed drain penetration detail for every applicable surface

rules.title_fa: حفاظت بازشوهای زیرزمین در برابر باران و رواناب

exceptions.predicate: verified geometry has no basement opening or below-grade enclosure

design_actions: materialize per-opening runoff interception and protected sill/areaway geometry and preserve below-grade waterproofing continuity

rules.title_fa: دسترسی مسیر و شفت و منع عبور از بخش خصوصی واحد دیگر
design_actions: compute route intersections with private-unit polygons; reroute eligible conflicts through common/service zones; materialize accessible shaft and smooth-finish detail

rules.title_fa: ارتفاع آزاد و جداسازی نگهدارنده تأسیسات از سقف کاذب

applicability.predicate: rainwater routes adjacent to or above suspended ceiling exist

exceptions.predicate: verified geometry has no suspended ceiling adjacent to a rainwater route

design_actions: compute finished clear height after pipe and ceiling depth; reject shared contact/support; preserve partitions and fire protection and materialize independent support detail

rules.title_fa: ایمنی و عقب‌نشینی لبه بام شیبدار از مرز ملک

exceptions.predicate: roof_type is source-verified not pitched

design_actions: compute downslope edge distance to property/public-way boundary by building group and floor count; materialize gutter/snow-retention and worker-safety anchor details without applying the flat-roof two-percent rule

rules.title_fa: زهکشی مسیر بیرونی، فضای نیمه‌باز، باز و گودال‌باغچه

exceptions.predicate: verified geometry has no applicable exterior space

design_actions: compute surface fall to drain/gutter, reject ponding and public-way discharge, keep sunken courtyards uncovered and provide cleaning access

rules.title_fa: زهکشی توقفگاه و جلوگیری از ورود رواناب به توقفگاه همکف

exceptions.predicate: verified geometry has no parking

design_actions: compute parking fall to surface drain and verify ground-floor entrance crest or approved alternative prevents exterior runoff entry

rules.title_fa: حفاظت نصب، نفوذ سازه‌ای و مسیرهای در معرض آسیب
design_actions: materialize sleeves/protection, corrosion and impact guards, approved structural openings, foundation-clear trench geometry, restored assemblies and outlet grates; prohibit rainwater piping in elevator shafts

rules.title_fa: جداسازی آب غیرآشامیدنی و حفاظت برگشت جریان

exceptions.predicate: verified project has no nonpotable/reuse or indirect-discharge connection

design_actions: keep potable and nonpotable networks physically identified and separated; materialize approved accessible backflow device or required air gap and indirect receptor detail

rules.title_fa: مدارک اجرایی، تصویب ناظر و تحویل نهایی مرحله‌ای

applicability.predicate: all design stages; approval and closeout evidence only at their applicable stages

design_actions: generate plans, riser, schedules, flow arrows, slopes, materials, details, outlet elevation and installation/protection/maintenance notes; request verified approval only at construction and verified closeout evidence only at final inspection

rules.title_fa: هدایت سرریز تجهیزات بام به دریافت‌کننده مجاز

applicability.predicate: roof equipment or storage overflow exists

exceptions.predicate: evaporative cooler may use roof rainwater drain as receptor

design_actions: draw a connected overflow route to an eligible receptor and prohibit loose roof discharge

rules.title_fa: تکمیل کنترل مصالح، مسیر ثقلی، اتصال و تکیه‌گاه

exceptions.predicate: smooth expansion piece is not required at a basement expansion-joint crossing

design_actions: materialize gravity routes, standard fittings, accessible concrete exceptions, expansion/fire seals and plastic vertical supports

rules.title_fa: حفاظت شرطی تخریب، آب آشامیدنی و مخزن مجاور شبکه باران

applicability.predicate: demolition, potable makeup, or potable storage adjacency exists

exceptions.predicate: each condition is explicitly verified absent

design_actions: require verified utility disconnection at demolition stage, certified potable-side components, and keep potable tanks away from flood/groundwater and overhead nonpotable routes

rules.title_fa: بار مرده اجزای دائم و لوله پرآب آب باران
design_actions: schedule actual permanent component mass and water-full operating mass and transmit support reactions plus foreseeable fixed additions for structural approval

rules.title_fa: تأیید انطباق ماژول مالک architecture

sources.clause: owner-module clauses listed by source id

applicability.predicate: rainwater design relies on owner-module architecture/structural requirements

design_actions: consume the canonical architecture compliance manifest; never duplicate or infer owner-module PASS
output_evidence: verified architecture compliance manifest identity and status

rules.title_fa: تأیید انطباق ماژول مالک structural

sources.clause: owner-module clauses listed by source id

applicability.predicate: rainwater design relies on owner-module architecture/structural requirements

design_actions: consume the canonical structural compliance manifest; never duplicate or infer owner-module PASS
output_evidence: verified structural compliance manifest identity and status

rules.title_fa: دسترسی بام، خرپشته و هندسه جان‌پناه

exceptions.predicate: for fewer than four storeys, roof slope over 33 percent, or verified no-use roof, public stair is not mandated

design_actions: select compliant roof access; draw headhouse within stair enclosure footprint and a continuous minimum 1.10 m parapet around accessible roof

rules.title_fa: تراز پاگرد و محدودیت آستانه ورودی

exceptions.predicate: non-accessible, non-egress exterior door may use at most one approved step height

design_actions: coordinate equal landing elevations; limit threshold drop to 20 mm on accessible/egress routes, 38 mm otherwise, or one approved step at an eligible exterior door; omit thresholds in listed public occupancies
output_evidence: per-entrance landing and threshold elevation schedule

rules.title_fa: سربار باران بر برف و ناسازگاری حالت‌های همزمان

applicability.predicate: snow region and roof slope/run are known

exceptions.predicate: only snow regions 2 and 3 with roof slope below W/15 degrees receive the surcharge

design_actions: compute the W/15-degree applicability boundary; add exactly 0.25 kN/m2 to balanced snow only and keep it out of drift, sliding, unbalanced and partial-snow cases

rules.title_fa: بار زنده بام، مسیر سرویس، تجهیزات و نردبان
design_actions: assign minimum uniform and concentrated loads by roof/service type; apply fixed-ladder loads and preserve adverse pattern checks for reduced integrity-member roof loads

rules.title_fa: استاندارد جنس، علامت دفن و جزئیات اتصال

exceptions.predicate: equivalent material standard requires explicit approval

design_actions: select an allowed or explicitly approved material standard, compatible fittings, burial marking and material-specific joint; preserve temperature, water-column and pre-test exposure limits

rules.title_fa: جزئیات بست و تکیه‌گاه لوله بر حسب جنس و جهت
design_actions: select material/orientation-specific clamp and support, connect it to the building, preserve thermal movement, and detail cast-iron bearing/bedding and insulated galvanized-steel liners
output_evidence: base bearing, sand bedding and insulation liner detail

rules.title_fa: فاصله هوایی خروجی آب آشامیدنی از دهانه آب باران

applicability.predicate: potable outlet discharges over an open rainwater receptor

exceptions.predicate: verified absence of applicable potable outlets

design_actions: dimension the vertical air gap from outlet underside to receptor overflow rim using outlet class, effective diameter and near-wall condition

rules.title_fa: بازمحاسبه ترکیب‌بارهای LRFD شامل بار باران

applicability.predicate: LRFD structural design includes roof rain load R

design_actions: evaluate every printed LRFD base combination using signed, dimensionally compatible load effects; expand each Lr/S/R alternative and both signs of W/E, identify the governing absolute effect only for a declared symmetric capacity envelope
output_evidence: structural analysis identity and capacity comparison

rules.title_fa: بازمحاسبه ترکیب‌بارهای تنش مجاز شامل بار باران

applicability.predicate: ASD structural design includes roof rain load R

design_actions: evaluate all ten printed ASD combinations with Lr/S/R alternatives and both signed W/E directions; prohibit allowable-stress increase for these combinations
output_evidence: structural analysis identity and allowable-capacity comparison

rules.title_fa: بار باران در گرفتگی تخلیه اصلی و پایداری برکه‌ای شدن

applicability.predicate: roof can retain water when its primary rainwater drainage is blocked

design_actions: derive ds from undeformed roof and secondary-inlet elevations, take dh from the design-flow hydraulic calculation, compute R=0.01(ds+dh), and perform iterative deformed-geometry ponding analysis for susceptible bays using the larger applicable rain or snow load

rules.title_fa: مبنای بار برف بام و هندسه برف‌گیری

applicability.predicate: roof is subject to snow load

design_actions: derive Cs from actual roof angle, thermal factor and verified sliding/fall geometry; recompute Pr, snow unit weight and balanced depth; reject contradicted exposed-roof classifications; double Pr over the eligible eave-overhang zone limited to 1.5 m

rules.title_fa: انباشت برف کنار خرپشته، تجهیزات و جان‌پناه

applicability.predicate: snow region 4, 5 or 6 and parapet or eligible rooftop raised feature exists

exceptions.predicate: raised-feature face width < 4.5 m

design_actions: select lu from actual geometry; independently compute relation 6-7-5 as drift width w=hd^2/hc; preserve the printed clause anomaly that describes 0.75 of that width relation as a maximum height and require an explicit structural interpretation instead of silently treating width as height

rules.title_fa: الحاق اثر بار سیال به ترکیب‌بارها

applicability.predicate: fluid load F acts on the structure

design_actions: apply F using the dead-load coefficient in every source-listed LRFD and ASD base case without collapsing signed or dimensionally different effects

rules.title_fa: استقرار سازه‌ای و لرزه‌ای تجهیزات سنگین بام

applicability.predicate: heavy equipment is placed on roof structure

design_actions: avoid cantilever, slender-member and long-span placement unless a model-bound structural analysis approves it; require Standard 2800 nonstructural seismic analysis for high/very-high importance buildings and medium-importance buildings of five or more storeys

rules.title_fa: کاهش بار زنده بام معمولی و سایبان

applicability.predicate: ordinary flat, pitched or curved roof or canopy

design_actions: derive R1 from member tributary area; derive S as slope percent for pitched roofs or 267 times rise/span for curved and domed roofs, never from degree angle; compute R2 and Lr=L0*R1*R2 only for ordinary roofs/canopies and enforce the printed limits

rules.title_fa: کاهش بار زنده بام با کاربری خاص

applicability.predicate: roof has special use such as roof garden and is not an assembly roof

design_actions: use a separate approved section 6-5-5 calculation bound to the same model; never apply the ordinary-roof R1/R2 formula or reduce below its approved result

rules.title_fa: کنترل افتادگی بهره‌برداری اعضای بام

applicability.predicate: roof structural member has a serviceability deflection limit

design_actions: compare model-computed vertical deflection for the declared serviceability combination with span divided by the governing design-code ratio; verify response and approval against the same model hash

rules.title_fa: مسیر هندسی دسترسی نگهداری و نظافت آب باران

applicability.predicate: rainwater equipment-only corridor, patio/lightwell or exterior element requires maintenance access

design_actions: materialize a continuous unobstructed access polyline to each cleaning/maintenance target and keep MEP-only corridor clear width at least 0.60 m

rules.title_fa: هندسه شیبراه در رابط ورود رواناب توقفگاه

applicability.predicate: a parking ramp participates in the project exterior-runoff or parking-entry drainage interface

exceptions.predicate: verified absence of applicable parking ramp

design_actions: derive every ramp slope from station/elevation geometry, keep first and last one-metre zones at or below 10 percent, apply the source-specific body limit, and coordinate the resulting entry profile with interceptor/drain placement
